summary: AmperCap Acquisition Company filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 12,500,000 units at $10.00 per unit, generating $125M in gross proceeds. The filing also notes entry into standard IPO agreements (underwriting, business combination marketing, share rights, letter agreement, and investment management trust). There is no special-situation event — no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC business combination, or abrupt management change. This is a routine IPO-related current report. What to watch: the SPAC has 18–24 months to identify and consummate a business combination; risk-arb investors should monitor trust account balance and any pre-deal leaks.
